sample_unit: physician survey respondents (plus 7 interviewed key informants)

links.outcome: Physician-perceived usability and workflow fit of CDS during pilot
links.effect: Pilot end-user interviews and survey (51 of 76 responded, 67.1%) identified needed changes to CDS accessibility, functionality, and workflow integration.
links.quote: Physicians suggested changes to CDS accessibility, functionality, and workflow integration.

unlisted_practices: Using a passive, non-mandatory CDS prompt that encourages but does not require physician interaction
Mixed-methods interview-then-survey elicitation of ED physician perceptions of CDS during a pilot

screen.reason: Mixed-methods usability and workflow evaluation of an emergency department heart failure clinical decision support (risk estimation and prescribing support) tool piloted in clinical practice.
